content: {"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-UI-REGISTER-PAGE", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "UI", "name": "RegisterPage", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/RegisterPage.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Owned registration page reached from the unique 'Create an account' link on the sign-in page; renders exactly the labeled Username, Email, Password, Confirm password, 'Agree to the terms' checkbox and 'Create account' button, none of them disabled.", "specification": "Renders one textbox labeled 'Username' (id register-username), one textbox labeled 'Email' (register-email), one password input labeled 'Password' (register-password), one password input labeled 'Confirm password' (register-confirm-password), one initially unchecked checkbox labeled 'Agree to the terms' (register-terms), and one enabled button named 'Create account'. Password values are never echoed as text and no password material is displayed after success. Submit handler is currently a documented no-op skeleton. TDD must implement handleSubmit so it: (1) builds all violations at once via collectRegistrationErrors, (2) calls submitRegistration for server conflicts, (3) calls setErrors with the union of client+server field messages (username/email/password/confirmPassword/terms/form) rendered via role=\"alert\" beside the matching field, (4) keeps the attempted username and email when anything fails and creates nothing, (5) on success navigates to SIGN_IN_ROUTE + '?registered=' + encodeURIComponent(username) and leaves the form clean so reopening register shows no account for a failed attempt. Exports REGISTER_ROUTE='/register' and SIGN_IN_ROUTE='/signin'.", "inputs": "User typing into username/email/password/confirmPassword; checkbox toggle; form submit event.", "outputs": "Field-level error markup (role=alert, aria-describedby wiring), navigation to /signin?registered=<username> on success.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-APP-ROUTES (route /register)", "REQ-1-1-1-UI-SIGN-IN-PAGE (Create an account link)"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-FUNC-REGISTRATION-RULES", "REQ-1-1-1-API-REGISTER-CLIENT"], "test_focus": "Label/role presence and enabled submit button; multi-field invalid submission (e.g. '-badname', 'not-an-email', 'short', 'different', unchecked terms) shows username+email+password+terms messages together and preserves the username value; duplicate username shows 'Username already exists' and retains both attempted values; successful registration reaches the sign-in page and the password text never appears in the DOM."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-UI-SIGN-IN-PAGE", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "UI", "name": "SignInPage", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/SignInPage.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Account-access page that hosts the unique 'Create an account' link and, after registration, the immediately usable sign-in form.", "specification": "Exports SIGN_IN_ROUTE='/signin', WORKSPACE_ROUTE='/', and REGISTER_ROUTE re-exported from RegisterPage. Interaction contract for TDD: submits identifier+password through the shared session state's signIn(identifier, password) (SessionProvider), which writes the authenticated user into global state; on success navigate to WORKSPACE_ROUTE; on failure keep the page, show an itemised message and leave session state unchanged. When the URL carries ?registered=<username>, render a status message (role=status) telling the visitor the account was created and to sign in with their email. The email used at registration must be accepted here. No password value is echoed.", "inputs": "identifier (username or email), password, optional ?registered=<username> query param.", "outputs": "Session transition via useSession().signIn, navigation to the workspace, role=status registration notice, role=alert failure message.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-APP-ROUTES (route /signin)", "Home page 'Sign in' entry"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER", "REQ-1-1-1-API-SESSION-CLIENT"], "test_focus": "Sign-in with a just-registered @example.test email enters the workspace; failed sign-in shows a message and does not authenticate; the 'Create an account' link navigates to /register."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "UI", "name": "SessionProvider / useSession", "file_path": "frontend/src/session/SessionProvider.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Single global authentication source of truth shared by header, registration page, sign-in page and route guards; restores authenticated state from the durable cookie session on mount.", "specification": "Materialized skeleton exports SessionContextValue { user: SessionUser | null; loading: boolean; setUser(user); signIn(identifier, password): Promise<SessionUser>; signOut(): Promise<void> }, the SessionProvider component and the useSession() hook that throws outside a provider. TDD must finalize the bootstrap effect so getCurrentUser() resolves the persisted session (keeping the signed-in username visible after reload), tolerate transport errors without crashing, expose loading while unresolved, and route signIn/signOut through sessionApi so global state, cookie session and DB session rows stay consistent. Must be mounted once in frontend/src/main.tsx around <App /> (REQ-1-1-1-UI-APP-ROOT).", "inputs": "children; signIn(identifier, password); setUser(user); signOut().", "outputs": "Global session context value consumed by every auth surface; loading flag for initial restore.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-APP-ROOT", "REQ-1-1-1-UI-SIGN-IN-PAGE", "REQ-1-1-1-UI-REGISTER-PAGE", "REQ-1-1-1-UI-ACCOUNT-HEADER"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-API-SESSION-CLIENT"], "test_focus": "useSession returns null user before any action, the registered user after sign-in, and the same user after a reload/remount driven by the session API; useSession outside the provider throws."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-UI-ACCOUNT-HEADER", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "UI", "name": "AccountHeader", "file_path": "frontend/src/session/AccountHeader.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Reused session-aware chrome that shows the current username (or guest entry links) using the same global session state as the pages.", "specification": "New owned UI contract (no parent shell interface existed): renders the current user's username when useSession().user is set and 'Sign in'/'Create an account' entries when it is null; may offer sign-out via useSession().signOut. TDD creates this module and mounts it from the workspace/registration surfaces. Must not hold local copies of the user state, and must not render hardcoded header text.", "inputs": "Global session state from useSession().", "outputs": "Header markup exposing the signed-in username for assertions; sign-out control.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-APP-ROUTES (workspace shell)"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER"], "test_focus": "Header shows no user before sign-in; the newly registered account's username is visible after sign-in and remains visible after reload."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-UI-APP-ROUTES", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "UI", "name": "SPA route registration for auth pages", "file_path": "frontend/src/App.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Registers the owned route slots (/register, /signin) alongside the existing home/workspace route so the auth pages are reachable in the backend-hosted build.", "specification": "Extend the existing <Routes> block: keep path '/' (home/workspace) and add path SIGN_IN_ROUTE -> SignInPage and path REGISTER_ROUTE -> RegisterPage, importing the routes from their owners rather than duplicating string literals. No new router instance; BrowserRouter stays in frontend/src/main.tsx. Paths must resolve to the real pages of REQ-1-1-1 so a full-page reload on /register or /signin works through the Express SPA fallback.", "inputs": "Browser location.", "outputs": "Rendered auth pages for /register and /signin.", "callers": ["frontend/src/main.tsx (App mount)"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-REGISTER-PAGE", "REQ-1-1-1-UI-SIGN-IN-PAGE"], "test_focus": "Direct navigation to /register renders the registration form; direct navigation to /signin renders the sign-in form."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-UI-APP-ROOT", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "UI", "name": "Application root provider mount", "file_path": "frontend/src/main.tsx", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Mounts the shared SessionProvider once above the router so every surface (header, sign-in, register, workspace) reads one auth source of truth.", "specification": "Wrap the existing <App /> (inside BrowserRouter, inside React.StrictMode) with <SessionProvider>. No other global state container for auth may be introduced; apiClient stays the single HTTP client. TDD keeps this thin.", "inputs": "Root DOM element.", "outputs": "App tree with global session context available.", "callers": ["frontend/index.html entry"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER"], "test_focus": "Rendering the app with a persisted session cookie shows the authenticated username without re-login."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-FUNC-REGISTRATION-RULES", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "FUNC", "name": "Client registration validation rules", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/registrationRules.ts", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Single client-side definition of the registration field rules and messages, used to render every violated field message in one submission.", "specification": "Materialized skeleton exports: types RegistrationField ('username'|'email'|'password'|'confirmPassword'|'terms'|'form'), RegistrationInput { username, email, password, confirmPassword, agreeToTerms }, RegistrationFieldErrors (Partial<Record<RegistrationField,string>>); constants USERNAME_PATTERN /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/, USERNAME_MIN_LENGTH 1, USERNAME_MAX_LENGTH 39, EMAIL_MAX_LENGTH 254, PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH 12, PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH 128 and the uppercase/lowercase/digit/special/whitespace patterns; REGISTRATION_MESSAGES with the exact required strings. Functions to implement (currently NotImplementedError stubs): normalizeEmail(email) trims whitespace; isEmailFormatValid(email) requires length<=254, exactly one '@', at least one dot and non-empty domain labels after '@'; isUsernameFormatValid(username) requires 1-39 chars matching USERNAME_PATTERN (no leading/trailing hyphen, lowercase ASCII letters/digits/single hyphens); isPasswordCompliant(password) requires 12-128 chars containing uppercase, lowercase, digit and a non-alphanumeric char with no whitespace; collectRegistrationErrors(input) returns every violated field at once (never one error per submission) using REGISTRATION_MESSAGES, including termsRequired when agreeToTerms !== true and a confirmPassword mismatch message.", "inputs": "RegistrationInput values from RegisterPage state.", "outputs": "RegistrationFieldErrors with zero or more field messages.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-REGISTER-PAGE"], "callees": [], "test_focus": "Rule table parity with backend/src/services/auth_service.js: boundary usernames (1 and 39 chars accepted; leading/trailing hyphen and uppercase rejected), email edge cases ('not-an-email', missing dot, empty domain label, >254 chars, surrounding whitespace trimmed then accepted), password cases (11 vs 12 chars, missing class, containing whitespace) and multi-field aggregation returning several keys in one call."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-API-REGISTER-CLIENT", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "API", "name": "Registration HTTP client", "file_path": "frontend/src/features/auth/registerApi.ts", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Thin typed boundary from the registration form to POST /api/auth/register, normalising per-field server errors.", "specification": "Materialized skeleton exports RegistrationRequestPayload { username, email, password, confirmPassword, agreeToTerms }, RegisteredUserSummary { id, username, email, emailVerified }, RegistrationResponse { code, message, user?, errors? }, RegistrationRequestFailure { code, message, errors } and submitRegistration(payload): Promise<RegistrationResponse>. Implemented: normalizeFailure() maps an axios error to { code: status, message, errors } so the page can render field messages including 409 conflicts. TDD completes the request through the shared apiClient (frontend/src/api) with the endpoint '/auth/register'; global axios interceptors remain responsible for transport-level handling. Must never resolve on a non-2xx response and must not invent success data.", "inputs": "RegistrationRequestPayload from RegisterPage.", "outputs": "RegistrationResponse with the created user on 201; rejects with RegistrationRequestFailure carrying { username?: 'Username already exists' } etc.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-REGISTER-PAGE"], "callees": ["frontend/src/api (shared axios client)", "REQ-1-1-1-API-AUTH-ROUTES"], "test_focus": "201 surfaces the created user; 400/409 rejections expose `errors` per field; network failure resolves to a renderable generic message instead of a fake success."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-API-SESSION-CLIENT", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "API", "name": "Session HTTP client", "file_path": "frontend/src/session/sessionApi.ts", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Durable 'who am I'/sign-in/sign-out boundary over the cookie session used for the authenticated state produced by registration.", "specification": "Materialized skeleton exports SessionUser { id, username, email, emailVerified }, SignInPayload { identifier, password }, getCurrentUser(): Promise<SessionUser | null>, signInRequest(payload): Promise<SessionUser>, signOutRequest(): Promise<void>. TDD implements them via the shared apiClient with withCredentials: true: GET /api/auth/session (200 with user or null for guests, never a 401 crash), POST /api/auth/signin ({ user }), POST /api/auth/signout. No token is stored in JS: the backend owns the httpOnly cookie, and failure paths reject with an Error whose message is safe to render.", "inputs": "SignInPayload from SignInPage/SessionProvider; no arguments for the restore/logout calls.", "outputs": "Current SessionUser or null; SessionUser after sign-in; void after sign-out.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-UI-SESSION-PROVIDER"], "callees": ["frontend/src/api (shared axios client)", "REQ-1-1-1-API-AUTH-ROUTES"], "test_focus": "Guests resolve to null without throwing; a session cookie restores the user; wrong credentials reject and leave global state unauthenticated; sign-out clears the restored user."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-API-AUTH-ROUTES", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "API", "name": "Auth HTTP routes", "file_path": "backend/src/routes/auth_routes.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Owned Express route module for registration and the cookie-session endpoints, mounted once under /api/auth.", "specification": "Materialized skeleton exposes an express.Router with POST /register delegating to auth_service.registerAccount and mapping the result to HTTP (201 { code, message: 'Registration successful', user } | 400 { code, message: 'Registration failed', errors } | 409 conflict with errors.username or errors.email). TDD must add to this same module (no parallel route tree): POST /signin (body { identifier, password } -> 200 { code, message, user } or 401 { code, message }), POST /signout (204/200 and cookie/session invalidation), GET /session (200 { code, message, user } or { code, message, user: null } for guests, using the session cookie; must not 500 for anonymous visitors). Every handler stays a thin transport mapper over auth_service. The module must be mounted in backend/src/app.js via app.use('/api/auth', require('./routes/auth_routes')) while keeping the existing '/api/health' route and SPA fallback intact.", "inputs": "JSON bodies { username, email, password, confirmPassword, agreeToTerms } and { identifier, password }; request cookies.", "outputs": "JSON { code, message, user? , errors? } with 200/201/400/401/409 status codes; Set-Cookie for the session.", "callers": ["backend/src/app.js route registration", "REQ-1-1-1-API-REGISTER-CLIENT", "REQ-1-1-1-API-SESSION-CLIENT"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE", "REQ-1-1-1-DB-USER-SCHEMA"], "test_focus": "Supertest coverage of /api/auth/register (success, multi-field 400 with all errors, 409 username and 409 email conflicts), /api/auth/session for anonymous and signed-in callers, /api/auth/signin with the seeded and the newly registered account, /api/auth/signout clearing the session; no password material in any response body."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "FUNC", "name": "Auth service (registration, credentials, sessions)", "file_path": "backend/src/services/auth_service.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Authoritative registration validation/conflict/creation workflow plus sign-in credential verification and session issue/load/revoke logic.", "specification": "Materialized skeleton already contains the server mirrors of the client rules and messages, MESSAGES, normalizeEmail, isEmailFormatValid, isUsernameFormatValid, isPasswordCompliant and collectRegistrationErrors (accumulating every violated field, including confirmPassword mismatch and terms), and the registerAccount(input) stub. TDD implements registerAccount: return 400 { ok:false, status:400, message:'Registration failed', errors } when collectRegistrationErrors finds anything; then conflict-check through the users repository and return 409 with exactly { username: 'Username already exists' } or { email: 'Email already exists' }; then store a sign-in-capable account with username, normalized email, hashed password (salt + hash, never the raw password) and email_verified = 1, returning { ok:true, status:201, message:'Registration successful', user: { id, username, email, emailVerified: true } }. TDD also adds authenticateCredentials({ identifier, password }) accepting username or email, createSession(userId) producing a durable session record + cookie value, loadSessionUser(sessionId) resolving the current user, and revokeSession(sessionId). No plain-text password may appear in any returned value or log.", "inputs": "registerAccount: { username, email, password, confirmPassword, agreeToTerms }; authenticateCredentials: { identifier, password }; session helpers: userId/sessionId.", "outputs": "{ ok, status, message, errors? } | { user } | session id/cookie value | null.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-API-AUTH-ROUTES"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-DB-USERS-REPOSITORY", "REQ-1-1-1-DB-SESSIONS-REPOSITORY"], "test_focus": "Every rule boundary mirrors the client tests; conflicts after a valid-format duplicate; created account is immediately usable via authenticateCredentials with the email; failed validations create no row (reopening register shows no account); password hash differs from the submitted password."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-DB-USERS-REPOSITORY", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "DB", "name": "Users repository", "file_path": "backend/src/repositories/users_repository.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Owned persistence boundary for account rows (create with verified email, lookup by username/email, safe projection).", "specification": "Skeleton to create (recorded here; the stage write cap was reached). Exports toApiUser(row) -> { id, username, email, emailVerified } | null, findByUsername(username), findByEmail(email), createUser({ username, email, passwordHash, passwordSalt, emailVerified }) using the shared helpers from backend/src/database/db_runtime.js (run/get). Emails are stored trimmed/lowercased-normalized as produced by normalizeEmail; username and email carry UNIQUE constraints so duplicates raise a constraint error the service maps to the field messages. Never selects or returns password_hash/password_salt to callers outside the service. Existing-user lookups are exact-match on the stored normalized values.", "inputs": "username, email, and the credential record to insert.", "outputs": "User row objects; safe API projection via toApiUser; constraint errors surfaced to the service.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE"], "callees": ["backend/src/database/db_runtime.js", "REQ-1-1-1-DB-USER-SCHEMA"], "test_focus": "createUser then findByEmail returns emailVerified true; duplicate username and duplicate email each raise a constraint error; lookups by trimmed email succeed; returned objects contain no password material."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-DB-SESSIONS-REPOSITORY", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "DB", "name": "Sessions repository", "file_path": "backend/src/repositories/sessions_repository.js", "first_line": "1", "responsibility": "Owned persistence boundary for durable sign-in sessions so authenticated state survives reloads.", "specification": "Skeleton to create (recorded here; the stage write cap was reached). Exports createSession({ id, userId, expiresAt }), findSession(id) returning { id, userId, expiresAt } | null (rejecting expired rows), deleteSession(id), and deleteSessionsForUser(userId) on demand. Uses the shared backend/src/database/db_runtime.js helpers only; no ad-hoc connections. Session ids are opaque random values safe for an httpOnly cookie; the raw credential never appears in a session record.", "inputs": "session id, user id, expiry timestamp.", "outputs": "Session row / null after delete.", "callers": ["REQ-1-1-1-FUNC-AUTH-SERVICE"], "callees": ["backend/src/database/db_runtime.js", "REQ-1-1-1-DB-USER-SCHEMA"], "test_focus": "A created session resolves its user; sign-out deletes the row so the next /api/auth/session is anonymous; expired sessions are not returned."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-DB-USER-SCHEMA", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "DB", "name": "Users and sessions schema lifecycle", "file_path": "backend/src/database/init_db.js", "first_line": "57", "responsibility": "Central idempotent schema definition for account and session persistence, consumed by every runtime and test DB path.", "specification": "Edit the existing scaffold inside initializeDatabase (after PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON) with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements: users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, password_salt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', email_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) and sessions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL). email_verified defaults to 1 because registration marks the email verified immediately and the product has no follow-up verification page. Keep evolution idempotent and centralized here; no feature-level connection or table creation elsewhere.", "inputs": "Existing initializeDatabase(options) call from backend/src/app.js, the test harness and the runtime.", "outputs": "users and sessions tables available on every connection.", "callers": ["backend/src/app.js startup", "backend/src/database/test_harness.js", "REQ-1-1-1-DB-USERS-REPOSITORY", "REQ-1-1-1-DB-SESSIONS-REPOSITORY"], "callees": [], "test_focus": "initializeDatabase twice is idempotent; a fresh test DB exposes both tables with the UNIQUE constraints enforced."}

{"interface_id": "REQ-1-1-1-DB-SEED-ACCOUNTS", "req_id": "REQ-1-1-1", "type": "DB", "name": "Deterministic account seed", "file_path": "backend/src/database/seed_db.js", "first_line": "6", "responsibility": "Provides the pre-existing account required by the scenarios (alice-dev / alice.dev@example.test / Valid-password-123!) through the normal application seed path.", "specification": "Edit the existing seedDatabase() entrypoint (inside its withTransaction) so it idempotently upserts the seeded account: username 'alice-dev', email 'alice.dev@example.test', the password 'Valid-password-123!' stored only as the same salt+hash format auth_service uses, and email_verified = 1, so the seeded account is sign-in capable. Use INSERT OR IGNORE / UPSERT semantics keyed on username and email so repeated seeding or reset produces exactly one row, and keep the insertion in this shared entrypoint (also invoked by the test harness and prepare_e2e) rather than in feature folders or test-only fixtures. Do not seed the newly registered accounts from the success scenario; those rows must come from real registration.", "inputs": "None; called from backend startup/seed scripts, the test harness and prepare_e2e.", "outputs": "Exactly one seeded account row on first run and no duplicates afterwards.", "callers": ["backend/src/database/seed_db.js CLI", "backend/src/database/test_harness.js (seedDefault/seed)", "backend/src/database/prepare_e2e.js"], "callees": ["REQ-1-1-1-DB-USER-SCHEMA", "backend/src/database/db_runtime.js"], "test_focus": "After seeding, signing in as alice-dev / Valid-password-123! succeeds and re-seeding leaves a single row; the seeded password is never stored in plain text."}
